rationale_short: 报告给出了TRIFR、LSI、CIFR等实际绩效数据，并明确显示其超过内部目标，能够直接支撑“exceeding stretch targets across safety”的表述。

metric_name: Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate (TRIFR)
context_text: Our commitment to safety is embedded across every aspect of our operations, reflecting a culture that prioritises the health and safety of our people above all else. rationale_short: 报告提供了安全管理做法和TRIFR数据，但不足以量化证明“embedded across every aspect”及“above all else”这类全面且强烈的价值判断，存在证据不足的漂绿嫌疑。
